parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and the response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default)
*   **en**

parameters.name: ProxyId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT firewall.

parameters.name: Switch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the NAT firewall. Valid values:

*   open: yes
*   close: no

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw switch-security-proxy --lang zh --proxy-id proxy-natbf000000 --switch open --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw SwitchSecurityProxy --region cn-hangzhou --Switch open --ProxyId 'proxy-natbf000000' --Lang zh
